violations.affected_code: InkWell(onTap: () async {await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));if (context.mounted) {ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Copied to Clipboard')),);}},child: const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),child: Icon(Icons.content_copy, size: 16),),)
violations.explanation: Interactive widgets that only contain icons should provide a semantic label (e.g., via a Tooltip or Semantics widget) to describe their action for screen reader users.
